metrics.window_convention: WP-12ag / S2b-5 uses the next prior contiguous equivalent-length evaluation window before REP-0014 / OL-0014: 2022-04-12 through 2023-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. No separate IS metric convention is introduced; in_sample.sharpe records the same actual window Sharpe for schema continuity.

data_provenance.source_data_notes: OL-0015 derives from REP-0015. REP-0015 used the next prior contiguous equivalent-length non-cloned evaluation window, covering 2022-04-12 through 2023-04-11. This window is distinct from REP-0011 full-period evidence, REP-0012 final-local-data-year evidence, REP-0013 next-most-recent evidence, and REP-0014 prior-window evidence.

notes: WP-12ah derives OL-0015 from REP-0015. It covers H-004 / research_oos / post_wp_5b / exp_success_criteria. gross_pnl > 0 and cost_drag_fraction are copied from REP-0015. cost_drag_fraction is negative because net funding is favorable in the copied REP metrics; do not reinterpret this as policy/ranking authority. WP-12ah performs no EXP-success or D2 reconciliation. WP-12ah creates no REC and does not satisfy REC-5. No policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper/live, runtime, lifecycle, promotion, demotion, or protected-path authority is created.
